title: Reality Epistemic Element Set
source: converted from the rees.md decomposition table

orders.epistemic: The inquiry order: orientation, agency, target, access, representation, construction, operation, evaluation, communication, infrastructure, context.
orders.ontic: The parsed-reality order: segments, entities, processes, events, properties, relations, states, structures, causes.
orders.reflexive: Inquiry turned on itself: its own conditions, limits, and accounts.

roots.label: Reality Inquiry
roots.description: The organized inquiry system into reality: orientation, agency, target, access, representation, construction, operation, evaluation, communication, infrastructure, context, and its ontic ground.

children.label: Epistemic Orientation
children.description: Grouping: the directing structure of inquiry.

children.label: Epistemic Purpose
children.description: Grouping: intended ultimate effects and values.

children.label: Understanding Purpose
children.description: Telos: make a target intelligible in itself, independent of immediate use.

children.label: Explanation Purpose
children.description: Telos: identify the cause, mechanism, or relation that produces an outcome.

children.label: Prediction Purpose
children.description: Telos: forecast behavior or outcomes under stated conditions.

children.label: Intervention Purpose
children.description: Telos: support acting on the target with a predictable effect.

children.label: Compression Purpose
children.description: Telos: shorten description while preserving explanatory and predictive power.

children.label: Design Purpose
children.description: Telos: specify an artifact or arrangement that would satisfy a requirement.

children.label: Evaluation Purpose
children.description: Telos: judge performance, standing, or effectiveness against criteria.

children.label: Exploration Purpose
children.description: Telos: chart an unfamiliar target whose structure is not yet known.

children.label: Communication Purpose
children.description: Telos: make a representation understandable and adoptable by others.

children.label: Epistemic Question
children.description: Grouping: formulated questions directing inquiry toward a gap.

children.label: Universal What-Question
children.description: Question of identity or composition: what is the target made of, what kind is it.

children.label: Universal Why-Question
children.description: Question of cause or reason: why does the target behave as it does.

children.label: Universal How-Question
children.description: Question of mechanism or procedure: how does the target produce its effect.

children.label: Universal Whether-Question
children.description: Question of existence or standing: whether the target, relation, or effect obtains.

children.label: Universal How-Much-Question
children.description: Question of magnitude: how much of a quantity the target carries.

children.label: Universal What-If-Question
children.description: Question of counterfactual: what would happen were a condition changed.

children.label: Universal Which-Question
children.description: Question of selection: which among alternatives is the case or the best.

children.label: Universal When-Question
children.description: Question of temporal order: when an event occurs or a condition holds.

children.label: Universal Where-Question
children.description: Question of spatial or structural location: where the target sits.

children.label: Universal Who-Question
children.description: Question of agency: who or what performs, bears, or is affected.

children.label: Epistemic Goal
children.description: Grouping: desired epistemic outcomes toward which inquiry is directed.

children.label: Descriptive Goal
children.description: Goal: a warranted description of the target that survives checking.

children.label: Explanatory Goal
children.description: Goal: an account that makes the target's behavior follow from its structure.

children.label: Predictive Goal
children.description: Goal: an artifact whose forecasts match future observations within tolerance.

children.label: Prescriptive Goal
children.description: Goal: a warranted recommendation for action or design.

children.label: Instrumental Goal
children.description: Goal: a usable tool, method, or representation for further inquiry.

children.label: Reflexive Goal
children.description: Goal: an account of inquiry's own conditions and limits.

children.label: Epistemic Gap
children.description: Grouping: deficiencies in available knowledge relative to the target.

children.label: Missing Concept Gap
children.description: Gap: no concept yet parses a recurring aspect of the target.

children.label: Missing Data Gap
children.description: Gap: the observations needed to decide a question do not exist.

children.label: Missing Mechanism Gap
children.description: Gap: the process producing an observed regularity is unidentified.

children.label: Contradiction Gap
children.description: Gap: available descriptions conflict and demand resolution.

children.label: Measurement Gap
children.description: Gap: the target is not yet registrable under any available regime.

children.label: Theory Gap
children.description: Gap: no organizing account covers a range of known results.

children.label: Replication Gap
children.description: Gap: a reported result has not been independently reproduced.

children.label: Epistemic Role
children.description: Grouping: functions an element or agent performs within the inquiry.

children.label: Principal Inquirer
children.description: Role: bears the question and is accountable for the inquiry's standing.

children.label: Domain Expert
children.description: Role: holds the local concepts and precedents of the target.

children.label: Methodologist
children.description: Role: guards the fit between question, operation, and evidence.

children.label: Adversarial Reviewer
children.description: Role: attempts to falsify or break the construction.

children.label: Synthesizer
children.description: Role: merges partial results into a coherent account.

children.label: Steward
children.description: Role: preserves records, data, and provenance across the inquiry.

children.label: Epistemic Scope
children.description: Grouping: the declared extent and stopping of the inquiry.

children.label: Declared Scope
children.description: The aspects of reality the inquiry takes as relevant.

children.label: Stopping Criterion
children.description: The condition under which expansion of a branch is judged sufficient.

children.label: Boundary Condition
children.description: The domain of validity within which results are asserted to hold.

children.label: Epistemic Agency
children.description: Grouping: entities and organized activities performing epistemic operations.

children.label: Epistemic Agent
children.description: Grouping: entities capable of performing epistemic operations.

children.label: Inquirer
children.description: Agent that poses questions and seeks warranted answers.

children.label: Observer
children.description: Agent that registers aspects of the target under a regime.

children.label: Modeler
children.description: Agent that builds and calibrates representations of the target.

children.label: Experimenter
children.description: Agent that arranges conditions to elicit a discriminating effect.

children.label: Instrument
children.description: Non-human agent that couples a target to a registration.

children.label: Critic
children.description: Agent that evaluates constructions against standards.

children.label: Collective Inquirer
children.description: Organized group whose agency exceeds any member's.

children.label: Epistemic Act
children.description: Grouping: discrete epistemic actions.

children.label: Observing Act
children.description: One act of registering an aspect of the target.

children.label: Measuring Act
children.description: One act assigning a value under a unit and procedure.

children.label: Formulating Act
children.description: One act giving a question or statement explicit form.

children.label: Inferring Act
children.description: One act deriving a statement from premises.

children.label: Modeling Act
children.description: One act constructing or adjusting a representation.

children.label: Testing Act
children.description: One act confronting a construction with the target.

children.label: Recording Act
children.description: One act committing content to a durable medium.

children.label: Epistemic Activity
children.description: Grouping: organized sequences of acts toward a purpose.

children.label: Observing
children.description: Sustained registration of a target under a regime.

children.label: Measuring
children.description: Repeated assignment of values under a unit system.

children.label: Modeling
children.description: Iterated construction, calibration, and revision of a model.

children.label: Experimenting
children.description: Planned manipulation and comparison of conditions.

children.label: Formalizing
children.description: Translation of informal content into a formal system.

children.label: Proving
children.description: Derivation of claims from stated axioms by licensed rules.

children.label: Validating
children.description: Confrontation of a construction with criteria and evidence.

children.label: Reviewing
children.description: Independent assessment of a construction by peers.

children.label: Curating
children.description: Selection, description, and preservation of records and data.

children.label: Epistemic Target
children.description: Grouping: the addressed domain of inquiry.

children.label: Target Domain
children.description: Grouping: bounded domains selected as the subject of analysis.

children.label: Natural Domain
children.description: Domain of observer-independent entities and processes.

children.label: Formal Domain
children.description: Domain of abstract structures studied for internal necessity.

children.label: Artificial Domain
children.description: Domain of designed artifacts and their behavior.

children.label: Cognitive Domain
children.description: Domain of representation, inference, and decision.

children.label: Target Segment
children.description: Grouping: delimited portions of a domain under study.

children.label: Selected Segment
children.description: Bounded portion of reality cut out as the unit of analysis.

children.label: Sample
children.description: Finite selection drawn from a segment under a sampling rule.

children.label: Population
children.description: The whole from which a sample is drawn and to which results generalize.

children.label: Boundary Case
children.description: Segment at the edge of validity where the account is expected to strain.

children.label: Observable
children.description: Grouping: features registrable under an observational regime.

children.label: Measurable Property
children.description: Feature admitting assignment of a value under a unit.

children.label: Detected Event
children.description: Occurrence registered as having happened, with place and time.

children.label: Relational Feature
children.description: Feature of a pair or ensemble rather than of a single entity.

children.label: Latent Feature
children.description: Feature not directly registrable but inferable from observables.

children.label: Proxy
children.description: Registrable stand-in used when the target feature resists direct registration.

children.label: Epistemic Object
children.description: Grouping: constituted objects of inquiry.

children.label: Constituted Object
children.description: Target as recast into the objects the inquiry can operate on.

children.label: Unit of Analysis
children.description: The entity, act, or event at which variables are measured.

children.label: Case
children.description: One bounded instance of the unit prepared for comparison.

children.label: Variable
children.description: Constructed property taking distinguishable values across cases.

children.label: Epistemic Access
children.description: Grouping: means by which the target becomes registrable.

children.label: Observation Interface
children.description: Grouping: boundary mechanisms coupling target to system.

children.label: Measurement Interface
children.description: Physical arrangement transducing a property into a reading.

children.label: Survey Interface
children.description: Elicitation arrangement producing responses from a subject.

children.label: Instrument Interface
children.description: Device-mediated coupling yielding a machine-readable signal.

children.label: Simulation Interface
children.description: Sampling of a constructed system in place of the target.

children.label: Sensory Interface
children.description: Unmediated register an agent can perform without apparatus.

children.label: Observation Encoding
children.description: Grouping: encodings applied at the point of registration.

children.label: Unit Encoding
children.description: Binding of a registered magnitude to a unit of measure.

children.label: Scale Encoding
children.description: Mapping of a registered property onto a scale type.

children.label: Timestamp Encoding
children.description: Binding of a registration to a time reference.

children.label: Location Encoding
children.description: Binding of a registration to a spatial or structural reference.

children.label: Calibration Encoding
children.description: Correction of a reading by comparison to a standard.

children.label: Observation Record
children.description: Grouping: registered representations of observed aspects.

children.label: Measurement Record
children.description: A reading with unit, instrument, and condition noted.

children.label: Event Log
children.description: Ordered record of detected occurrences.

children.label: Response Record
children.description: Record of a subject's elicited answer under a survey regime.

children.label: Instrument Trace
children.description: Raw signal retained by a device before interpretation.

children.label: Field Note
children.description: Contemporaneous prose registration by an observer.

children.label: Epistemic Representation
children.description: Grouping: structures through which content is encoded and manipulated.

children.label: Representational System
children.description: Grouping: sign systems within which representations are formed.

children.label: Natural Language
children.description: System of spoken and written signs carrying everyday description.

children.label: Mathematical System
children.description: System of formal symbols and rules for structure and quantity.

children.label: Logical System
children.description: System of formal connectives and inference rules.

children.label: Diagrammatic System
children.description: System of spatial signs depicting structure and relation.

children.label: Statistical System
children.description: System of probabilistic and sampling constructs.

children.label: Computational System
children.description: System of executable rules and data structures.

children.label: Measurement System
children.description: System of units, scales, and their conventions.

children.label: Representation Element
children.description: Grouping: combinable constituents of a system.

children.label: Symbol
children.description: Atomic sign bearing content within the system.

children.label: Expression
children.description: Well-formed combination of symbols denoting content.

children.label: Variable Symbol
children.description: Sign ranging over values in a domain.

children.label: Operator
children.description: Sign combining expressions into new expressions.

children.label: Graph
children.description: Sign of relations rendered as points and edges.

children.label: Constitutive Substrate
children.description: Grouping: rules and structures constituting the system.

children.label: Convention
children.description: Grouping: stabilized notational choices.

children.label: Notation Convention
children.description: Agreed way of writing the system's expressions.

children.label: Unit Convention
children.description: Agreed magnitude and definition of a base unit.

children.label: Reference Frame
children.description: Agreed origin and axes against which quantities are stated.

children.label: Formation
children.description: Grouping: rules of well-formed combination.

children.label: Syntax Rule
children.description: Rule stating which symbol strings are well formed.

children.label: Type Discipline
children.description: Rules constraining combinations by kind of content.

children.label: Foundation
children.description: Grouping: axioms and foundings of the system.

children.label: Axiom Set
children.description: Undemonstrated assumptions from which the system proceeds.

children.label: Primitive Notion
children.description: Undefined term the system takes as given.

children.label: Definition
children.description: Introduced term fixed by stating its content in prior terms.

children.label: Interpretation
children.description: Grouping: meaning assignments to the system.

children.label: Model-Theoretic Interpretation
children.description: Assignment of the system's symbols to elements of a structure.

children.label: Physical Interpretation
children.description: Assignment of formal quantities to measurable properties.

children.label: Operational Interpretation
children.description: Assignment of a term to the operations that decide it.

children.label: Epistemic Construction
children.description: Grouping: artifacts produced to organize, preserve, explain, or extend knowledge.

children.label: Description
children.description: Grouping: structured affirmations about a segment of reality.

children.label: Descriptive Statement
children.description: An affirmation asserting what the target is or has.

children.label: Formal Description
children.description: A description carried in a formal system's expressions.

children.label: Statistical Description
children.description: A description by distribution, moment, or trend.

children.label: Qualitative Description
children.description: A description by category, kind, or aspect without magnitude.

children.label: Comparative Description
children.description: A description asserting a relation between two target states.

children.label: Concept
children.description: Grouping: constituents of thought that denote structures of reality.

children.label: Relational Concept
children.description: Concept denoting a relation among entities or processes.

children.label: Quantity Concept
children.description: Concept denoting a measurable magnitude.

children.label: Process Concept
children.description: Concept denoting a change or sequence over time.

children.label: Boundary Concept
children.description: Concept marking a distinction the inquiry depends on.

children.label: Typology Concept
children.description: Concept organizing instances into recognized kinds.

children.label: Model
children.description: Grouping: constructed representations manipulated in place of the target.

children.label: Deterministic Model
children.description: Model whose state fixes its future exactly.

children.label: Stochastic Model
children.description: Model whose outcomes are probabilistically distributed.

children.label: Mechanistic Model
children.description: Model exhibiting the arrangement that produces the effect.

children.label: Phenomenological Model
children.description: Model fitting behavior without claiming the mechanism.

children.label: Statistical Model
children.description: Model expressing how data are generated.

children.label: Simulation Model
children.description: Model run forward to generate synthetic states.

children.label: Causal Model
children.description: Model asserting which variables act on which.

children.label: Calibrated Model
children.description: Model whose parameters have been set against data.

children.label: Explanation
children.description: Grouping: descriptions clarifying cause, mechanism, or relation.

children.label: Causal Explanation
children.description: Explanation citing a cause and its effect.

children.label: Mechanistic Explanation
children.description: Explanation citing the arrangement that generates the effect.

children.label: Functional Explanation
children.description: Explanation citing the role a part plays in a whole.

children.label: Statistical Explanation
children.description: Explanation citing a distribution or propensity.

children.label: Deductive Explanation
children.description: Explanation deriving the outcome from law and condition.

children.label: Narrative Explanation
children.description: Explanation ordering events into an intelligible sequence.

children.label: Prediction
children.description: Grouping: claims about not-yet-registered states of the target.

children.label: Point Prediction
children.description: A single value asserted for a future state.

children.label: Interval Prediction
children.description: A range asserted to contain the future value.

children.label: Probabilistic Prediction
children.description: A distribution asserted over future outcomes.

children.label: Conditional Prediction
children.description: A prediction qualified by an assumed condition.

children.label: Extrapolative Prediction
children.description: A prediction beyond the range of the data.

children.label: Theory
children.description: Grouping: organizing accounts binding many results under few principles.

children.label: Axiomatic Theory
children.description: Theory whose claims follow from stated axioms.

children.label: Phenomenological Theory
children.description: Theory organizing regularities at the observable level.

children.label: Effective Theory
children.description: Theory valid within a declared range and scale.

children.label: Field Theory
children.description: Theory stated over a continuum of states.

children.label: Theory Family
children.description: Cluster of related theories over a shared domain.

children.label: Dataset
children.description: Grouping: organized sets of records prepared for operation.

children.label: Raw Dataset
children.description: Records as registered, before cleaning.

children.label: Processed Dataset
children.description: Records cleaned, aligned, and typed.

children.label: Derived Dataset
children.description: Records computed from other datasets.

children.label: Longitudinal Dataset
children.description: Records repeated over time for the same units.

children.label: Benchmark Dataset
children.description: Records fixed as a shared reference for comparison.

children.label: Record
children.description: Grouping: durable single-item accounts kept for later use.

children.label: Laboratory Record
children.description: Contemporaneous account of preparation and procedure.

children.label: Observation Notebook
children.description: Chronological register of observations and decisions.

children.label: Archival Record
children.description: Preserved item kept for provenance and later inquiry.

children.label: Provenance Record
children.description: Account of who produced what, when, and how.

children.label: Data Dictionary
children.description: Record defining fields, types, and units of a dataset.

children.label: Classification
children.description: Grouping: schemes sorting instances into kinds.

children.label: Taxonomy
children.description: Hierarchical scheme of kinds with inclusion relations.

children.label: Typology
children.description: Scheme of kinds distinguished by declared criteria.

children.label: Ontology
children.description: Scheme of kinds with explicit relations and constraints.

children.label: Coding Scheme
children.description: Scheme binding categories to symbols for tabulation.

children.label: Facet Scheme
children.description: Scheme combining independent dimensions of classification.

children.label: Narrative
children.description: Grouping: ordered accounts making a course of events intelligible.

children.label: Chronology
children.description: Account ordering events in time.

children.label: Case Study
children.description: Account of one bounded instance in depth.

children.label: Scenario
children.description: Account of a possible course under stated assumptions.

children.label: Synthesis Review
children.description: Account merging many results into a standing.

children.label: Epistemic Operation
children.description: Grouping: operations and procedures transforming epistemic content.

children.label: Action
children.description: Grouping: operations directly transforming, comparing, or deriving content.

children.label: Reckoning
children.description: Grouping: rule-governed transformation of represented quantities.

children.label: Procedure
children.description: Grouping: ordered routines of reckoning.

children.label: Arithmetic Routine
children.description: Ordered place-based summation and multiplication.

children.label: Algebraic Manipulation
children.description: Symbolic rearrangement preserving equality.

children.label: Numerical Integration
children.description: Approximation of a continuum by finite steps.

children.label: Symbolic Differentiation
children.description: Rule-based derivation of rates of change.

children.label: Statistical Estimation
children.description: Fitting parameters to data under a model.

children.label: Comparison
children.description: Operational act judging relation among content.

children.label: Measurement Operation
children.description: Act assigning a value under a unit and procedure.

children.label: Transformation
children.description: Act changing the form of content while preserving what matters.

children.label: Retrieval
children.description: Act locating content already held.

children.label: Search
children.description: Act exploring a space of candidates for content meeting a condition.

children.label: Inference
children.description: Grouping: derivations from premises.

children.label: Deduction
children.description: Grouping: necessary derivations from premises.

children.label: Proof by Induction
children.description: Base and step deriving a universal claim.

children.label: Proof by Contradiction
children.description: Assumption of the contrary deriving an impossibility.

children.label: Abduction
children.description: Inference to the best available explanation.

children.label: Analogy
children.description: Inference drawing on structural sameness across domains.

children.label: Statistical Inference
children.description: Inference from sample to population under a model.

children.label: Computation
children.description: Grouping: procedures executed over data.

children.label: Algorithm
children.description: Finite procedure deciding or producing an output.

children.label: Numerical Scheme
children.description: Discrete rule approximating a continuous process.

children.label: Simulation Run
children.description: One forward execution of a simulation model.

children.label: Optimization Routine
children.description: Procedure seeking an extremum of an objective.

children.label: Monte Carlo Estimate
children.description: Estimate from random sampling.

children.label: Organization
children.description: Grouping: organization of actions into reproducible structures.

children.label: Method
children.description: Grouping: generalized ways of proceeding.

children.label: Experimental Method
children.description: Controlled variation to isolate an effect.

children.label: Comparative Method
children.description: Systematic contrast across cases.

children.label: Modeling Method
children.description: Iterated construction and revision of models.

children.label: Statistical Method
children.description: Design and analysis under probabilistic assumptions.

children.label: Procedure
children.description: Grouping: fixed ordered steps.

children.label: Protocol
children.description: Steps fixed in advance for repeatability.

children.label: Calibration Procedure
children.description: Steps setting an instrument against a standard.

children.label: Principle
children.description: Grouping: rules guiding operation.

children.label: Conservation Principle
children.description: Invariance constraining admissible transformations.

children.label: Symmetry Principle
children.description: Invariance under a change of description.

children.label: Parsimony Principle
children.description: Prefer the account with fewest assumptions.

children.label: Workflow
children.description: Grouping: coordinated multi-step pipelines.

children.label: Data Pipeline
children.description: Sequence from registration through processing to use.

children.label: Research Programme
children.description: Long-horizon organization of related inquiries.

children.label: Epistemic Evaluation
children.description: Grouping: evaluative processes assessing constructions and operations.

children.label: Epistemic Standard
children.description: Grouping: standards by which content is judged.

children.label: Accuracy Standard
children.description: Content stands only if close to the target value.

children.label: Precision Standard
children.description: Content stands only if its spread is bounded.

children.label: Reproducibility Standard
children.description: Content stands only if reobtainable by others.

children.label: Validity Standard
children.description: Content stands only if it measures what it claims.

children.label: Reliability Standard
children.description: Content stands only if consistent across occasions.

children.label: Parsimony Standard
children.description: Content stands only if it does not multiply assumptions.

children.label: Falsifiability Standard
children.description: Content stands only if it forbids some observation.

children.label: Robustness Standard
children.description: Content stands only if it survives variation of assumptions.

children.label: Generality Standard
children.description: Content stands only within its declared boundary.

children.label: Epistemic Criterion
children.description: Grouping: evaluated properties of content.

children.label: Fidelity Criterion
children.description: Degree to which a model reproduces the target's behavior.

children.label: Coverage Criterion
children.description: Range of cases the account addresses.

children.label: Predictive Error Criterion
children.description: Discrepancy between prediction and observation.

children.label: Consistency Criterion
children.description: Freedom from internal contradiction.

children.label: Epistemic Constraint
children.description: Grouping: limits on what can be evaluated or done.

children.label: Computational Constraint
children.description: Bound on resources available to the operation.

children.label: Measurement Constraint
children.description: Bound on what a regime can register.

children.label: Ethical Constraint
children.description: Bound imposed by acceptable conduct.

children.label: Scope Constraint
children.description: Bound on the range the account may claim.

children.label: Resource Constraint
children.description: Bound on time, material, or money.

children.label: Error
children.description: Grouping: deviations from the warranted value.

children.label: Measurement Error
children.description: Deviation introduced by the registration interface.

children.label: Sampling Error
children.description: Deviation from drawing a finite sample.

children.label: Model Error
children.description: Deviation from the model's idealization.

children.label: Systematic Bias
children.description: Deviation that does not average out.

children.label: Random Noise
children.description: Deviation without assignable cause.

children.label: Rounding Error
children.description: Deviation from finite numerical representation.

children.label: Specification Error
children.description: Deviation from choosing the wrong model form.

children.label: Validation
children.description: Grouping: checks discharging doubt about content.

children.label: Prediction Test
children.description: Confrontation of a prediction with a withheld observation.

children.label: Replication
children.description: Independent reobtainment of a reported result.

children.label: Intervention Test
children.description: Alteration of a condition to see the predicted effect.

children.label: Cross-Validation
children.description: Checking fit on data withheld from calibration.

children.label: Calibration Check
children.description: Verification of an instrument against a standard.

children.label: Sensitivity Analysis
children.description: Variation of inputs to gauge output dependence.

children.label: Robustness Check
children.description: Reassessment under altered assumptions.

children.label: Feedback
children.description: Grouping: evaluations returned to the inquiry.

children.label: Model Revision
children.description: Adjustment of a model after a failed check.

children.label: Experimental Redesign
children.description: Change of regime after an uninformative result.

children.label: Standard Revision
children.description: Tightening or loosening of a standard after use.

children.label: Calibration Update
children.description: Correction of an interface after a calibration drift.

children.label: Epistemic Communication
children.description: Grouping: transmission, inscription, and coordination of content.

children.label: Epistemic Inscription
children.description: Grouping: persistent renderings of content.

children.label: Table
children.description: Content ordered by named rows and columns.

children.label: Figure
children.description: Content rendered as a selected graphical form.

children.label: Diagram
children.description: Content rendered as related spatial signs.

children.label: Notebook Entry
children.description: Dated inscription within an inquiry's running log.

children.label: Annotation
children.description: Note attached to an existing inscription.

children.label: Epistemic Publication
children.description: Grouping: released, citable content.

children.label: Article
children.description: Bounded published account of an inquiry.

children.label: Monograph
children.description: Book-length account of a domain or result.

children.label: Preprint
children.description: Account circulated before formal review.

children.label: Technical Report
children.description: Account prepared for a specific body or purpose.

children.label: Dataset Release
children.description: Public offering of a dataset with its dictionary.

children.label: Software Release
children.description: Public offering of an executable artifact.

children.label: Epistemic Coordination
children.description: Grouping: exchange coordinating an inquiry.

children.label: Memo
children.description: Brief directed communication within a group.

children.label: Correspondence
children.description: Sustained exchange between inquirers.

children.label: Conference Talk
children.description: Oral presentation of a result to peers.

children.label: Issue Thread
children.description: Running record of a problem and its resolution.

children.label: Epistemic Exchange
children.description: Grouping: structured critical interchange.

children.label: Peer Review
children.description: Structured assessment of a construction by peers.

children.label: Seminar
children.description: Recurring forum of presentation and critique.

children.label: Colloquium
children.description: Formal gathering presenting current work.

children.label: Replication Report
children.description: Published account attempting to reproduce a result.

children.label: Epistemic Infrastructure
children.description: Grouping: material, computational, informational, institutional structures enabling inquiry.

children.label: Epistemic Tool
children.description: Grouping: tools of the inquirer.

children.label: Instrument
children.description: Device coupling a target to a registration.

children.label: Calculator
children.description: Device performing reckoning for the inquirer.

children.label: Software Tool
children.description: Executable artifact supporting a modeling or analytic task.

children.label: Notebook
children.description: Bounded medium for running inscription.

children.label: Survey Kit
children.description: Instrument set for eliciting and recording responses.

children.label: Information Repository
children.description: Grouping: stored content made retrievable.

children.label: Archive
children.description: Long-term preserved collection with provenance.

children.label: Library
children.description: Curated collection organized for consultation.

children.label: Database
children.description: Structured store queried by a system.

children.label: Registry
children.description: Authoritative list of items with identifiers.

children.label: Catalogue
children.description: Described inventory of a collection.

children.label: Epistemic Institution
children.description: Grouping: bodies sustaining inquiry.

children.label: University
children.description: Body organizing teaching and research.

children.label: Laboratory
children.description: Bounded site instrumented for experiments.

children.label: Journal
children.description: Body reviewing and publishing accounts.

children.label: Funding Body
children.description: Body allocating resources to inquiry.

children.label: Standards Body
children.description: Body fixing conventions and reference values.

children.label: Learned Society
children.description: Body gathering practitioners of a domain.

children.label: Computational Substrate
children.description: Grouping: computational structures enabling operation.

children.label: Hardware
children.description: Physical machine executing operations.

children.label: Operating System
children.description: Software layer managing execution and storage.

children.label: Programming Language
children.description: Formal system for expressing executable procedures.

children.label: Version Control
children.description: System recording the history of artifacts.

children.label: Compute Cluster
children.description: Aggregated machines for large operations.

children.label: Material Substrate
children.description: Grouping: physical resources sustaining inquiry.

children.label: Physical Medium
children.description: Material bearing inscriptions and samples.

children.label: Energy Supply
children.description: Power required to run instruments and machines.

children.label: Reagent
children.description: Consumable material required by a procedure.

children.label: Facility
children.description: Built space and services hosting inquiry.

children.label: Epistemic Context
children.description: Grouping: surrounding conditions within which inquiry is situated.

children.label: Epistemic Condition
children.description: Grouping: conditions framing an inquiry.

children.label: Data Availability Condition
children.description: Whether the needed records exist and are reachable.

children.label: Tool Availability Condition
children.description: Whether the needed instruments and software exist.

children.label: Regulatory Condition
children.description: Legal and administrative constraints on the inquiry.

children.label: Publication Norm
children.description: Accepted standards for releasing results.

children.label: Funding Condition
children.description: Resources and their conditions of award.

children.label: Ethical Framework
children.description: Norms governing acceptable treatment of subjects and data.

children.label: Historical Condition
children.description: Grouping: the state of prior knowledge and tools at a time.

children.label: Prior Knowledge State
children.description: What is already established when the inquiry begins.

children.label: Intellectual Tradition
children.description: Inherited questions, methods, and standards.

children.label: Instrumental State of the Art
children.description: What current apparatus makes possible.

children.label: Social Condition
children.description: Grouping: the human setting of the inquiry.

children.label: Community of Practice
children.description: The peers who share and judge the inquiry's standards.

children.label: Institutional Incentive
children.description: Rewards shaping which questions are pursued.

children.label: Stakeholder Interest
children.description: Parties affected by or interested in the results.

children.label: Division of Cognitive Labour
children.description: Distribution of roles and expertise across the inquiry.

children.label: Ontic
children.description: Grouping: what exists, occurs, changes, or generates effects within a segment of reality.

children.label: Segment of Reality
children.description: Grouping: bounded portions of reality selected for inquiry.

children.label: Domain Segment
children.description: Region of reality picked out as the inquiry's domain.

children.label: Boundary Region
children.description: Region at the edge of a domain where a concept strains.

children.label: Scale Layer
children.description: Level of organization from micro to macro.

children.label: Entity
children.description: Grouping: what exists and bears properties.

children.label: Substance
children.description: Entity persisting through change.

children.label: Object
children.description: Bounded entity with boundaries and parts.

children.label: System
children.description: Organized ensemble of interacting parts.

children.label: Field
children.description: Entity distributed over a region and taking values there.

children.label: Process
children.description: Grouping: what occurs and unfolds.

children.label: Mechanism
children.description: Arrangement of structures generating an effect.

children.label: Interaction
children.description: Reciprocal action between entities.

children.label: Transformation
children.description: Change of a system's state under a process.

children.label: Cycle
children.description: Process returning to a prior state.

children.label: Event
children.description: Grouping: datable occurrences.

children.label: Occurrence
children.description: Something happening at a place and time.

children.label: Transition
children.description: Event marking passage between states.

children.label: Change
children.description: Event consisting in a difference between states.

children.label: Property
children.description: Grouping: what entities have or bear.

children.label: Quality
children.description: Property of kind or character.

children.label: Quantity
children.description: Property admitting magnitude and unit.

children.label: Disposition
children.description: Property of what an entity would do under conditions.

children.label: Relation
children.description: Grouping: what holds among entities and events.

children.label: Structural Relation
children.description: Relation of composition, part, or enclosure.

children.label: Causal Relation
children.description: Relation of producing or influencing an effect.

children.label: Functional Relation
children.description: Relation of serving a role in a whole.

children.label: Temporal Relation
children.description: Relation of precedence, simultaneity, or order.

children.label: State
children.description: Grouping: configurations an entity or system is in.

children.label: Configuration
children.description: Arrangement of parts at a moment.

children.label: Phase
children.description: Region of state space with uniform behavior.

children.label: Condition
children.description: State bearing on whether a process can proceed.

children.label: Structure
children.description: Grouping: persistent organization of a target.

children.label: Composition
children.description: What a whole is made of.

children.label: Organization
children.description: How the parts of a whole are related.

children.label: Pattern
children.description: Recurring organization across instances.

children.label: Cause
children.description: Grouping: what is responsible for an effect.

children.label: Efficient Cause
children.description: The agency or event producing a change.

children.label: Mechanistic Cause
children.description: The arrangement that yields the effect.

children.label: Probabilistic Cause
children.description: A factor raising the chance of an effect.

roots.label: Reflexive Inquiry
roots.description: Inquiry taking its own practice, conditions, and limits as its target.

children.label: Epistemic Target
children.description: Grouping: inquiry as the addressed target.

children.label: Knowing Gap
children.description: Deficiency in the account of how knowing works.

children.label: Limit of Knowing
children.description: Boundary beyond which the regime cannot register.

children.label: Instrument Effect
children.description: The target as altered by the act of registering it.

children.label: Epistemic Standard
children.description: Grouping: standards applied to inquiry itself.

children.label: Self-Application Standard
children.description: A standard stands only if the inquiry that states it also meets it.

children.label: Reflexivity Standard
children.description: An account stands only if it can describe its own production.

children.label: Epistemic Construction
children.description: Grouping: accounts of inquiry.

children.label: Epistemology
children.description: Account of the nature, conditions, and limits of knowing.

children.label: Methodology
children.description: Account of how inquiry should proceed.

children.label: Ontology
children.description: Account of what exists, in service of what can be known.

children.label: Epistemic Evaluation
children.description: Grouping: assessments of accounts of inquiry.

children.label: Philosophical Critique
children.description: Assessment of an account of knowing against its own claims.

children.label: Validation
children.description: Grouping: checks discharging doubt about accounts of inquiry.

children.label: Reflexive Test
children.description: An account of knowing is tried against the practice it describes.
